notes.text: Hip openers and long holds. The instructor suggested a block under the hands for pigeon pose.
notes.title: Yoga class

notes.text: Bench press 5x5, pull-ups 4x6, shoulder press 3x10, finished with planks.
notes.title: Upper body

notes.text: Rode 40 km along the river, headwind on the way back, average speed 24 km/h.
notes.title: Cycling log

notes.text: Ten minutes every morning: cat cow, thoracic rotations, hamstring stretch, hip flexor stretch.
notes.title: Mobility routine

notes.text: Long run on Sundays adding one km a week, tempo run on Wednesdays, rest day on Friday.
notes.title: Half marathon plan

notes.text: Check-up moved to Thursday at 3 pm. Ask about the sensitive tooth on the lower left.
notes.title: Dentist

notes.text: The kitchen tap drips. Call Mr Okoye on Monday; he can come Wednesday morning between 8 and 10.
notes.title: Plumber

notes.text: Eggs, oat milk, spinach, tomatoes, coffee beans, dishwasher tablets, bin bags.
notes.title: Groceries

notes.text: The photo must be taken against a white background; renewal takes about three weeks, so start before the summer.
notes.title: Passport renewal

notes.text: Annual service booked for the 22nd. Someone needs to be home; clear the space under the stairs.
notes.title: Boiler service

notes.text: Three books are due back on Saturday; renew the cookbook online if no one has reserved it.
notes.title: Library books

notes.text: For Mum: a silk scarf or a pottery class. For Dad: a good torch or a book on birds.
notes.title: Birthday gift ideas

notes.text: Wash the windows, sort the wardrobe, donate clothes that no longer fit, deep clean the oven.
notes.title: Spring cleaning

notes.text: Small changes compound. Make the cue obvious, the habit easy and the reward satisfying.
notes.title: Reading notes: Atomic Habits

notes.text: Practise the verbs for daily routines: despertarse, ducharse, desayunar. Ten new words each day.
notes.title: Spanish vocabulary

notes.text: A reminder app that nudges you to water plants only when the soil is dry, using a cheap moisture sensor.
notes.title: App idea

notes.text: Episodes for the commute: one about the history of salt, one about urban beekeeping.
notes.title: Podcast list

notes.text: Practise the open chords G, C, D and Em for fifteen minutes with the metronome at sixty beats per minute.
notes.title: Learn guitar

notes.text: Shoot at golden hour, use the rule of thirds, and keep the ISO low on a tripod for night scenes.
notes.title: Photography tips

notes.text: Finished the chapter on dictionaries and comprehensions. Exercise: count the words in a text file.
notes.title: Python course

notes.text: Five hundred words every morning before checking email. Draft the first chapter by the end of June.
notes.title: Writing goal

notes.text: Plant the seedlings after the last frost, water deeply twice a week, tie the stems to canes.
notes.title: Tomato plants

notes.text: Bruno's annual vaccination is due on the 9th. Also ask about his itchy ears and the dose of flea treatment.
notes.title: Dog vet visit

notes.text: Switch Miso to the salmon recipe gradually over a week to avoid an upset stomach.
notes.title: Cat food

notes.text: Mix kitchen scraps with dry leaves, turn the heap every two weeks, keep it damp but not soggy.
notes.title: Compost

notes.text: The monstera wants bright indirect light; the fern needs misting. Repot the rubber plant in spring.
notes.title: Houseplants

notes.text: Pump the tyres to 60 psi, oil the chain, check the brake pads before the weekend ride.
notes.title: Bike maintenance

notes.text: Restart the router when the connection drops; a firmware update is scheduled for Sunday night.
notes.title: Wifi router

notes.text: Pick a film everyone agrees on: the heist comedy won the vote. Popcorn and the big sofa.
notes.title: Movie night

notes.text: Redirect the post, book the removal van, take meter readings, label boxes by room.
notes.title: Moving checklist

notes.text: In bed by 22:30 all week, woke once in the night, felt rested. Cut caffeine after two in the afternoon.
notes.title: Sleep log

notes.text: Saturday at the school hall: lemon drizzle, brownies and flapjacks. We need volunteers for the tea table.
notes.title: Fundraiser bake sale

notes.text: The battery drains in two hours. Check background apps, lower the screen brightness, consider a replacement.
notes.title: Laptop battery
